sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners-Accused Nos.1 to 2 to quash the proceedings in CC.No.2988 of 2018 pending on the file of Principal Junior Civil Judge-Cum-VII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medhcal.

entities.text: Principal Junior Civil Judge-Cum-VII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medhcal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offences alleged against him are under Sections 188, 273 of IPC & 59 (i) food safety and standards Act,2006.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this case is squarely covered with the Common Order rendered by this Hon'ble Court in Criminal Petition Nos.9062 of 2021 and batch, dated 14.07.2022 pertaining to tobacco matters.

3. In view of the findings of this Court in the above batch cases, the present case when tobacco products were seized can be allowed, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings in C.C.No.2988 of 2018 are quashed.

Crl.Petition No.10697 of 2022 4. Registry to append a copy of the Common Order in Criminal Petition Nos.9062 of 2021 and batch, dated 14.07.2022 to this Order.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
_____________ K.SURENDER, J Date: 02.12.2022 PKR Crl.
